mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 78 degrees with clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School, with a moderate air quality index of 52. Tonight offers a great chance to see the International Space Station starting at 9:08 PM; look west over Mount Horeb as it travels northeast toward the Madison area near Home Depot, staying about halfway up the sky.

The Verona Police Department reported a burglary on September 10 where a 19-year-old was arrested on Hunters Cove Way after an officer recovered a handgun. Additionally, the department is accepting applications for their upcoming free nine-week Citizen Academy starting September 23.

Today features live music at both Baileys Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or catch the music series at Paddy Macs. Plus, dont miss the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival this Saturday.
On September 10, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way for a burglary in progress where a suspect was located and taken into custody after a firearm was discharged.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the Raspberry Cheesecake flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
